category: addon directory for Stremio (curated list, HTML only)

free_tier.stated: The directory is free to browse with no account. /api/addons returns 404, so there is no machine-readable feed.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a directory of addon manifests

retention.stated: listings persist while the addon is maintained; the front page sorts by new, recently updated, top rising and popular

egress.terms: no byte allowance: the directory links to each addon's own manifest host

interface_detail: HTML only: /api/addons 404s and there is no documented JSON endpoint. The addon pages carry an install URL, which is the only machine-usable artefact.
tooling: A browser, or a scraper over the listing pages; the install URL per addon is a plain stremio:// or https manifest link that a client can consume directly.
chaining: Use it to enumerate candidate addons, then install the two or three that matter and let AIOStreams collapse them into one request per title.

limits.value: none published; the listing pages answered normally with no 429

limits_note: No API means no documented quota; the constraint is that enumeration is HTML parsing.
binding_note: Nothing here is metered and no rate was observed; the directory is a discovery surface, not a data source a client would poll.

identity_cost.detail: No account to read; saving favourites is the only feature the site ties to a sign-in.

reliability_note: The listing carries sponsored placements (TorrinSearch, NodStack) at the top, so ranking is partly paid and an entry's position is not a quality signal.
confidence_note: The home page and one sorted listing were read on 2026-10-23, and /api/addons was probed and 404d. A scrape of the full listing would settle how many entries it carries.

evidence.proved: 'Community curated Stremio addons list', new/recently updated/top rising/popular sections, and two sponsored placements above the fold
HTTP 404, so no JSON API is served at the obvious path
